answer: In a decentralized quill-based proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured through zero-knowledge reputation commitments. An attacker faces an economic cost proportional to the number of pseudonyms they create, incurring a prohibitive capital lockup equivalent to the value of a full-grown cedar tree. This mechanism mathematically sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by ensuring each agent's vote in the quill grove carries unique quills representing verifiable credentials, thwarting Sybil attacks.
